speaker: john_heminges
text: Egeon, then the wait. You open it. The play goes on without you until the close.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know the shape. The old speech is the old speech. I am not improving it in a doorway.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The house is in. Speak the father, and come off. I will find you when the last scene wants the same man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The same man. I will be here. I am not spending the middle of it on a new sentence.

speaker: will_kemp
text: The twins can be funny without a father watching them do it. Go and sit where the draught is.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No figure from me before the play. We count when there is something to count.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then count on another day. I am on.
